target.title: feat(durable): add opt-in workflow worker loop
target.body:
## Context capsule

This is PR5/5 in the durable runtime stack. It follows PR4 and adds the opt-in workflow worker loop after the durable core, agent recovery semantics, and schema lifecycle have each been reviewed separately.


## Durable core stack overview

Durable core means the shared, opt-in runtime substrate that records run identity, step/event ordering, parent/child links, bounded refs, recovery states, signals/timers, and read-only inspection for long-running OpenClaw agent/session/task/subagent work. It is needed because local incidents and related public PRs show repeated coordinator-silence, stale-running-session, non-durable parent handoff, restart recovery, and bespoke durable-delivery fixes that cannot be solved cleanly by one product surface alone. The core is intentionally below Task Flow, Workboard, plugins, sessions, and channel UI: those can project from it, but they should not own the persistence boundary.

The full stack is: PR1 #101828 docs-only RFC/root-cause/canonical boundary; PR2 #102495 durable runtime core with SQLite state, lifecycle primitives, gateway/operator surfaces, QR repair, and tests; PR3 agent/session/subagent restart and upgrade-safety proof; PR4 schema lifecycle/recovery hardening; PR5 opt-in workflow worker loop. Promotion remains sequential: PR3 waits for PR1+PR2 threshold, PR4 waits for PR3, and PR5 waits for PR4.

This PR is PR5/5: it adds the opt-in worker loop after the persistence/recovery stack is accepted.

## Stack position

- Stack item: PR5/5
- Canonical upstream gates: PR1 #101828 threshold-met; PR2 pending; PR3 and PR4 must become threshold_met first.
- This PR head: `codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-worker-pr5-v2-submit` at `41d433a127` (`feat(durable): add opt-in workflow worker loop`)
- Intended base: final threshold-met PR4 head.

## Dependency / promotion gate

- Submit gate: PR4 must be threshold_met.
- Current gate state: waiting on PR2, PR3, and PR4 promotion sequence.
- Stack completion gate: after PR5 reaches threshold and PR1-PR4 remain threshold_met, stop durable-stack cron/session follow-up.

## What Problem This Solves

Once durable state and recovery semantics are accepted, OpenClaw needs an opt-in worker loop that can execute durable workflow work without forcing the behavior on default installs. This PR adds that worker surface last so reviewers can assess runtime automation separately from core persistence and upgrade mechanics.

## Scope

- Opt-in durable workflow worker loop.
- Worker-focused durable runtime tests.
- Gateway/durable tests needed to prove the worker integrates safely with the accepted core.

## Non-scope

- Does not change the PR2 durable core boundary.
- Does not introduce schema lifecycle work beyond what PR4 owns.
- Does not enable worker behavior by default unless the final diff explicitly documents the flag/default.

## Base / diff hygiene

- Base comparison: expected final PR4 head once PR4 is threshold-met.
- Branch/head verified with `git rev-parse --short=10 codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-worker-pr5-v2-submit && git log -1 --oneline`.
- Non-cumulative check must be rerun before submit against final PR4 base.

## Proof matrix

| Gate | Command / artifact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Head verification | `git rev-parse --short=10 codex/openclaw-durable-runtime-worker-pr5-v2-submit && git log -1 --oneline` | passed; `41d433a127 feat(durable): add opt-in workflow worker loop` |
| Focused worker/durable tests | `CI=true ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/durable/*.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts src/agents/workflow-worker.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts` | passed 2026-07-09T14:10+07; 7 files / 25 tests |
| Artifact | `/tmp/pr5-proof-linked-goodnm-20260709.log` | available locally |
| Dependency caveat | used known-good `node_modules` from canonical PR2 worktree; avoided `pnpm exec` after disk pressure/reinstall risk | recorded in state |
| Diff hygiene | rerun `git log --oneline --reverse <final-pr4-base>..HEAD` and `git diff --name-status <final-pr4-base>..HEAD` before submit | pending final base |
| Live proof | optional `openclaw e` worker smoke after PR4 gate clears | pending |

## Live proof

No PR5-specific `openclaw e` worker-loop smoke is recorded yet. Before or soon after PR5 submission, prefer an opt-in local-e smoke that demonstrates the worker loop stays disabled by default and runs only when explicitly enabled.

## ClawSweeper requirements

- Includes authored `What Problem This Solves`: yes.
- Includes authored `Evidence`: yes.
- Names worker enablement/default behavior: required in final body.
- Names stored data model impact: inherited from PR2/PR4 unless final diff adds new persisted fields.
- Keeps proof artifacts accessible: yes.

## Risk / upgrade notes

- Primary risk is unintended background execution; mitigate by documenting and proving opt-in/default-disabled behavior.
- Secondary risk is interaction with durable SQLite state and recovery loops; PR4 schema lifecycle gate must land first.
- Avoid dependency reinstall commands in the affected recovery worktree until node_modules is intentionally restored.

## Evidence

- PR5 submit branch exists at `41d433a127`.
- Focused durable/gateway/worker vitest gate passed: 7 files / 25 tests, including `src/durable/worker.test.ts` coverage reported by vitest.
- Artifact: `/tmp/pr5-proof-linked-goodnm-20260709.log`.

## Next gate

Wait for PR4 to reach gold_shrimp_schrimp threshold, then rebase/recompare PR5 against final PR4, rerun worker proof and optional `openclaw e` opt-in smoke, submit PR5, and stop follow-up only after PR1-PR5 all meet threshold.
